        <div class="td-content">
          
          <h1>Troubleshooting Meshery Installations</h1>
           <h2 id="mesherys-preflight-checks">Meshery’s Preflight Checks</h2>

<p>Anytime a <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl system</code> command is executed, a series of preflight checks are run. An attempt will be made to connect to the Kubernetes cluster configured in the user’s kubeconfig as their current-context .</p>

<ol>
  <li>
    <p>Check whether <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> can initialize a Kubernetes client.</p>

    <p>Situation: <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> fails to query for pods in the default namespace of the user’s current Kubernetes context.</p>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Remove <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">~/.meshery</code> to reinitialize Meshery</p>

    <p>Situation: Unable to start Meshery Server with <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">make run-local</code> due to error of <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">key/value size is invalid</code></p>
  </li>
</ol>

<h2 id="setting-up-meshery-using-kind-or-minikube">Setting up Meshery using Kind or Minikube</h2>

<p>The difficulty with Minikube and Kind clusters is that they typically don’t support LoadBalancer service networking by default. Meshery UI and Meshery Broker are configured for LoadBalancer service networking by default. There are a number of solutions this overcoming this challenge. Here are a few methods:</p>

<ol>
  <li>
    <p>Use the MetalLB Minikube add-on that provides load balancing. <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">minikube addons enable metallb</code></p>

    <p>MetalLB setup: <a href="https://kubebyexample.com/learning-paths/metallb/install">link</a></p>
  </li>
  <li>
    <p>Use Minikube tunnel to expose services. <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">minikube tunnel</code>.</p>

    <p>Docs: <a href="https://minikube.sigs.k8s.io/docs/handbook/accessing/#using-minikube-tunnel">link</a></p>

    <p>A simpler way to resolve this issue can be <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">port-forwarding</code>. Run the following command in terminal:</p>

    <p><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">kubectl port-forward service/meshery 9081:9081 -n meshery</code></p>
  </li>
</ol>

<p>Note: The <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">--port-forward</code> flag is intended for use exclusively when Meshery is deployed in a Kubernetes cluster (<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">platform: kubernetes</code>).</p>

<ol>
  <li>
    <p>For <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">kind</code>, you can prefer installing MetalLB with a custom configmap.</p>

    <p>Docs: <a href="https://kind.sigs.k8s.io/docs/user/loadbalancer/">link</a></p>
  </li>
</ol>

<h2 id="meshery-operator">Meshery Operator</h2>

<p>By default, Meshery Operator is installed in all the connected clusters automatically once Meshery server detects those clusters. The operator can manually be turned off on particular cluster from the settings page.</p>

<h3 id="disabling-the-operator">Disabling the operator</h3>

<p>The env variable DISABLE_OPERATOR=true can be used to signal Meshery server to not install operator in any of the clusters at any point in time after starting. While using Meshery server locally, the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">make server-without-operator</code> should be used to start Meshery in disabled operator mode.</p>

<h3 id="meshery-broker">Meshery Broker</h3>

<p>Example of a healthy Meshery Broker server with an actively connected (subscribed) Meshery Server:</p>

<div class="language-shell highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>➜  ~ kubectl logs <span class="nt">-n</span> meshery meshery-broker-0 nats
<span class="o">[</span>8] 2021/09/08 21:46:03.070952 <span class="o">[</span>INF] Starting nats-server version 2.1.9
<span class="o">[</span>8] 2021/09/08 21:46:03.070982 <span class="o">[</span>INF] Git commit <span class="o">[</span>7c76626]
<span class="o">[</span>8] 2021/09/08 21:46:03.071308 <span class="o">[</span>INF] Starting http monitor on 0.0.0.0:8222
<span class="o">[</span>8] 2021/09/08 21:46:03.071370 <span class="o">[</span>INF] Listening <span class="k">for </span>client connections on 0.0.0.0:4222
<span class="o">[</span>8] 2021/09/08 21:46:03.071512 <span class="o">[</span>INF] Server <span class="nb">id </span>is NAAYJNX4LDDNXW5UE7IP7PRQR2W2JP546XSFNUWQQHN7JYY27RG47KSG
<span class="o">[</span>8] 2021/09/08 21:46:03.071516 <span class="o">[</span>INF] Server is ready
</code></pre></div></div>

<p>For details about the state of the Meshery Server subscription see the http monitor port on Meshery Broker.</p>

<h3 id="meshery-unable-to-connect-to-kubernetes">Meshery Unable to Connect to Kubernetes</h3>

<p>Meshery is unable to detect the Kubernetes connection running on your local system, even after manually uploading the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">.kube config</code> file</p>

<p>When deploying Meshery out-of-cluster, verify your kubeconfig’s contexts and the ability for Meshery Server to reach Kubernetes cluster API from whatever host and network that Meshery Server is being deployed on.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock"><div class="clipboardjs">kubectl config get-contexts</div></div>
</pre>

<p>If you’re using Docker Desktop, consider whether you need to change your current Kubernetes context to <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">docker-desktop</code>.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre">
<div class="codeblock"><div class="clipboardjs">kubectl config use-context
docker-desktop</div></div>
</pre>

<h2 id="meshery-remote-providers">Meshery Remote Providers</h2>

<p>Once Meshery is installed, the remote provider “Meshery” can be chosen from UI or by using the command <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl system login</code>:</p>

<p><img src="/v0.8/assets/img/providers/provider_screenshot.png" alt="Providers" /></p>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>➜  ~ mesheryctl system login
Use the arrow keys to navigate: ↓ ↑ → ←
? Select a Provider:
  ▸ Meshery
    None
</code></pre></div></div>

<p>If you cannot see “Meshery” Remote Provider and find such error logs in Meshery Server’s logs (<code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl system logs</code>), please make sure that Meshery Server is able to reach “https://cloud.meshery.io” in order to initialize the “Meshery” Remote Provider.</p>

<div class="language-bash highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code><span class="nb">time</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"2021-11-10T11:05:30Z"</span> <span class="nv">level</span><span class="o">=</span>error <span class="nv">msg</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"[Initialize Provider]: Failed to get capabilities Get </span><span class="se">\"</span><span class="s2">https://cloud.meshery.io/v0.5.71/capabilities?os=meshery</span><span class="se">\"</span><span class="s2">: dial tcp 3.140.89.205:443: i/o timeout"</span>
</code></pre></div></div>

<p>For more details about Meshery Providers:</p>

<ul>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/extensibility/providers">Extensibility: Providers</a></li>
</ul>

          <h1>Meshery Operator, MeshSync, Broker Troubleshooting Guide</h1>
           <div class="alert alert-info">
<h4 class="alert-heading">What is Meshery Operator?</h4>
<a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/operator">Meshery Operator</a> controls and monitors the lifecycle of components deployed inside Meshery-managed Kubernetes clusters. Learn more about <a href="/v0.8/concepts">Meshery's architecture</a>.
</div>

<p>This guide offers comprehensive for troubleshooting instructions for <a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/operator">Meshery Operator</a> and its custom controllers, <a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/meshsync">MeshSync</a> and <a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/broker">Broker</a>. Follow the steps outlined in this document to ensure a smooth Meshery deployment.</p>

<p>First, understand the <a href="#meshery-operator-deployment-scenarios">Meshery Operator Deployment Scenarios</a> and the <a href="#understanding-the-status-of-meshery-operator-meshsync-and-meshery-broker">Status of Meshery Operator, MeshSync, and Meshery Broker</a> to identify the deployment model fitting of your environment. Then, follow the guidance under the respective scenario to troubleshoot accordingly.</p>

<div class="alert alert-dark">
<h4 class="alert-heading">Meshery Error Code Reference</h4>
Have specific error with an error code? See the <a href="/v0.8/reference/error-codes">Meshery Error Code Reference</a> for probable cause and suggested remediations.
</div>

<h2 id="understanding-the-status-of-meshery-operator-meshsync-and-meshery-broker">Understanding the Status of Meshery Operator, MeshSync, and Meshery Broker</h2>

<p>Each Meshery Operator controller offers a health status that you can use to understand their current health in your deployment. Their health statuses and meanings are described below.of MeshSync and Meshery Broker.</p>

<h3 id="meshery-operator-health-status">Meshery Operator Health Status</h3>

<ul>
  <li><strong>DEPLOYED:</strong> Operator deployment rollout is done, pod is in a ready state, old pod (if any) has been terminated.</li>
  <li><strong>DEPLOYING:</strong> Operator deployment is present, but its rollout is in progress. Pod is not yet in ready state, or old pod has not been terminated.</li>
  <li><strong>NOTDEPLOYED:</strong> Operator deployment is not present in the cluster.</li>
</ul>

<h3 id="meshsync-health-status">MeshSync Health Status</h3>

<ul>
  <li><strong>ENABLED:</strong> Custom Resource present. MeshSync Controller is not connected to Broker.</li>
  <li><strong>DEPLOYED:</strong> Custom Resource present. MeshSync Controller is present but the state is not RUNNING or ERRDISABLE, though</li>
  <li><strong>RUNNING:</strong> MeshSync pod present and in a running state.</li>
  <li><strong>CONNECTED:</strong> Deployed and connected to Broker.</li>
  <li><strong>UNDEPLOYED:</strong> Custom Resource not present.</li>
</ul>

<h3 id="meshery-broker-health-status">Meshery Broker Health Status</h3>

<ul>
  <li><strong>DEPLOYED:</strong> External IP not exposed OR External IP exposed but Meshery Server is not connected as a client to Broker hence data is not being published.</li>
  <li><strong>UNDEPLOYED:</strong> Custom Resource not deployed.</li>
  <li><strong>CONNECTED:</strong> Deployed, sending data to Meshery Server.</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="meshery-operator-deployment-scenarios">Meshery Operator Deployment Scenarios</h2>

<p>Because Meshery is versatile in its deployment models, there are different of scenarios in which you may need to troubleshoot the health of Meshery Operator. Identify the deployment model fitting of your environment and follow the guidance under the respective scenario to troublshoot accordingly.</p>

<h3 id="in-cluster-deployment">In-Cluster Deployment</h3>

<!-- Meshery Operator, MeshSync, and Broker are deployed in the same cluster as Meshery Server. This is the default deployment scenario when using `mesheryctl system start` or `make run-local`. -->

<p>Whether using <a href="/v0.8/installation"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl system start</code></a>, <a href="/v0.8/installation/kubernetes/helm"><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">helm install</code></a> or <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">make run-local</code>, Meshery Server will automatically connect to any available Kubernetes clusters found in your kubeconfig (under <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">$HOME/.kube/config</code>). Once connected, operator, broker(NATS) and meshsync will automatically get deployed in the same clusters.</p>

<p>If everything is fine, by viewing the connection in Meshery UI, MeshSync should be in <strong>CONNECTED:</strong> state. Otherwise, check the Operator’s pod logs:</p>

<p><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">kubectl logs &lt;meshery-operator-pod&gt; -n meshery</code></p>

<h3 id="out-of-cluster-deployment">Out-of-Cluster Deployment</h3>

<ol>
  <li>Meshery Server is deployed on any Docker host (- Meshery Server is deployed on a Docker host, and Meshery Operator is deployed on a Kubernetes cluster).
<em>or</em></li>
  <li>Meshery is managing multiple clusters, some of which are not the cluster unto which Meshery Server is deployed.</li>
</ol>

<h2 id="common-failure-scenarios">Common Failure Scenarios</h2>

<p>Some common failure situations that Meshery users might face are described below.</p>

<ol>
  <li><strong>Situation:</strong> No deployment of Meshery Operator, MeshSync, and Broker.
    <ol>
      <li><strong>Probable cause:</strong> Meshery Server cannot connect to Kubernetes cluster; cluster unreachable or kubeconfig without proper permissions needed to deploy Meshery Operator; Kubernetes config initialization issues.</li>
    </ol>
  </li>
  <li><strong>Situation:</strong> Meshery Operator with MeshSync and Broker deployed, but Meshery Server is not receiving data from MeshSync or data the <a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/database">Meshery Database</a> is stale.
    <ol>
      <li><strong>Probable cause:</strong></li>
      <li>Meshery Server lost subscription to Meshery Broker; Broker server not exposed to external IP; MeshSync not connected to Broker; MeshSync not running; Meshery Database is stale.</li>
      <li>The SQL database in Meshery serves as a cache for cluster state. A single button allows users to dump/reset the Meshery Database.</li>
      <li>Orphaned MeshSync and Broker controllers - Meshery Operator is not present, but MeshSync and Broker controllers are running.</li>
    </ol>
  </li>
</ol>

<h2 id="operating-meshery-without-meshery-operator">Operating Meshery without Meshery Operator</h2>

<p>Meshery Operator, MeshSync, and Broker are crucial components in a Meshery deployment. Meshery can function without them, but some functions of Meshery will be disable / unusable. Whether Meshery Operator is initially deployed via <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code> command or via Meshery Server, you can monitor the health of the Meshery Operator deployment using either the CLI or UI clients.</p>

<h2 id="verifying-the-status-of-meshery-operator-meshsync-and-meshery-broker">Verifying the Status of Meshery Operator, MeshSync, and Meshery Broker</h2>

<h2 id="troubleshooting-using-meshery-cli">Troubleshooting using Meshery CLI</h2>

<p>The following commands are available to troubleshoot Meshery Operator, MeshSync, and Broker.</p>

<p><strong>Meshery Server and Adapters</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl system status</code> - Displays the status of Meshery Server and Meshery Adapters.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Meshery Operator, MeshSync, and Broker</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl system check</code> - Displays the status of Meshery Operator, MeshSync, and Broker.</li>
</ul>

<h2 id="troubleshooting-using-meshery-ui">Troubleshooting using Meshery UI</h2>

<p>Based on discussed scenarios, the UI exposes tools to perform the following actions:</p>

<ul>
  <li>(Re)deploy Operator, MeshSync, Broker.</li>
  <li>Uninstall and Install MeshSync, Broker, Operator.</li>
  <li>Reset Database.</li>
  <li>Ad hoc Connectivity Test for Operator, Meshery Broker, MeshSync.</li>
  <li>Reconnect Meshery Server to Meshery Broker.</li>
  <li>Ad hoc Connectivity Test for Kubernetes context.</li>
  <li>Rediscover kubeconfig, delete, (re)upload kubeconfig.</li>
</ul>

<h3 id="synthetic-test-for-ensuring-change-in-cluster-state">Synthetic Test for Ensuring Change in Cluster State</h3>

<p>Initiate a synthetic check to verify a fully functional Operator deployment, testing MeshSync/Broker connectivity.</p>

<ul>
  <li>Empty database shows the main-cluster node.</li>
  <li>Corrupt database triggers an error snackbar with a link to the Settings screen.</li>
  <li>Disconnected Kubernetes displays MeshSync logo pulsating when data is received.</li>
</ul>

<div class="section">
Future Enhancements for Troubleshooting:

- NATS/MeshSync not running prompts a review of available operations in the Settings panel.

</div>

<ul>

  <li><a href="/v0.8/guides/troubleshooting/meshery-server">Troubleshooting Errors while running Meshery</a></li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

          <h1>Troubleshooting Errors while running Meshery</h1>
           <h2 id="mesheryctl-system-start">mesheryctl system start</h2>

<p><strong>Error:</strong></p>

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>mesheryctl system start : : cannot start Meshery: rendered manifests contain a resource that already exists.
Unable to continue with install: ServiceAccount "meshery-operator" in namespace "meshery" exists and cannot
be imported into the current release: invalid ownership metadata; label validation error: missing key
"app.kubernetes.io/managed-by": must be set to "Helm"; annotation validation error: missing key
"meta.helm.sh/release-name": must be set to "meshery"; annotation validation error: missing key
"meta.helm.sh/release-namespace": must be set to "meshery"
</code></pre></div></div>

<p><strong>(Fix) Clean the cluster using :</strong></p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">
kubectl delete ns meshery
kubectl delete clusterroles.rbac.authorization.k8s.io meshery-controller-role meshery-operator-role meshery-proxy-role meshery-metrics-reader
kubectl delete clusterrolebindings.rbac.authorization.k8s.io meshery-controller-rolebinding meshery-operator-rolebinding meshery-proxy-rolebinding
 </div></div>
 </pre>

<p><em>Issue Reference : <a href="https://github.com/meshery/meshery/issues/4578">https://github.com/meshery/meshery/issues/4578</a></em></p>

<h3 id="make-server">make server</h3>

<p><strong>Error:</strong></p>

<div class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge"><div class="highlight"><pre class="highlight"><code>FATA[0000] constraints not implemented on sqlite, consider using DisableForeignKeyConstraintWhenMigrating, more details https://github.com/go-gorm/gorm/wiki/GORM-V2-Release-Note-Draft#all-new-migrator
exit status 1
make: *** [Makefile:76: server] Error 1
</code></pre></div></div>

<p><strong>Fix:</strong></p>

<ol>
  <li>Flush the database by deleting the <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">.meshery/config</code></li>
  <li><code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">make server</code></li>
</ol>

<h4 id="see-also">See Also</h4>

<ul>
  <li><a href="/v0.8/reference/error-codes">Error Code Reference</a></li>
</ul>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

    <!-- CONCEPTS -->

  <div class="section">
    <a href="/v0.8/concepts">
        <div class="btn-primary">Concepts</div>
    </a>
    <details>
      <summary>
        <p style="display:inline">
          <a href="/v0.8/concepts/logical" class="text-black">Logical</a>
        </p>
      </summary>
      <ul class="section-title">
        
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/logical/components">Components</a>
          
         - Meshery Components identify and characterize infrastructure under management.
          
          </li>
          
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/logical/connections">Connections</a>
          
         - Meshery Connections are managed and unmanaged resources that either through discovery or manual entry are managed by a state machine and used within one or more Environments.
          
          </li>
          
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/logical/credentials">Credentials</a>
          
         - Meshery uses one or more Credentials when authenticating to a managed or unmanaged Connection.
          
          </li>
          
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/logical/designs">Designs</a>
          
         - Meshery Designs are descriptive, declarative characterizations of how your Kubernetes infrastructure should be configured.
          
          </li>
          
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/logical/environments">Environments</a>
          
         - Environments are how you organize your deployment targets (whether on-premises servers or cloud services) into resource groups.
          
          </li>
          
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/logical/models">Models</a>
          
         - Meshery uses a set of resource models to define concrete boundaries to ensure extensible and sustainable management.
          
          </li>
          
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/logical/patterns">Patterns</a>
          
         - Meshery Patterns are descriptive, declarative characterizations of how your Kubernetes infrastructure should be configured.
          
          </li>
          
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/logical/policies">Policies</a>
          
         - Meshery Policies enable you with a broad set of controls and governance of the behavior of systems under Meshery's management.
          
          </li>
          
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/logical/registry">Registry</a>
          
         - Meshery Registry is a database acting as the central repository for all capabilities known to Meshery. These capabilities encompass various entities, including models, components, relationships, and policies.
          
          </li>
          
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/logical/relationships">Relationships</a>
          
         - Meshery Relationships identify and facilitate genealogy between Components.
          
          </li>
          
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/logical/workspaces">Workspaces</a>
          
         - Meshery Workspaces act as central collaboration point for teams.
          
          </li>
          
        
      </ul>
    </details>
    <details>
      <summary>
        <p style="display:inline">
          <a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture" class="text-black section-title">Architectural</a>
        </p>
      </summary>
      <ul>
        
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/adapters">Adapters</a>
            
            - Adapters extend Meshery's management capabilities in any number of ways, including lifecycle, configuration, performance, governance, identity...
            
          </li>
        
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture">Architecture</a>
            
            - overview of different individual components of Meshery architecture and how they interact as a system.
            
          </li>
        
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/broker">Broker</a>
            
            - Meshery broker component facilitates data streaming between Kubernetes cluster components and the outside world.
            
          </li>
        
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/catalog">Catalog</a>
            
            - Browsing and using cloud native patterns
            
          </li>
        
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/database">Database</a>
            
            - Meshery offers support for internal caching with the help of file databases. This has been implemented with several libraries that supports different kinds of data formats.
            
          </li>
        
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/meshsync">MeshSync</a>
            
            - MeshSync ensures Meshery Server is continuously in-sync with the state of infrastructure under management.
            
          </li>
        
        
        <li><a href="/v0.8/concepts/architecture/operator">Operator</a>
            
            - Meshery Operator controls and manages the lifecycle of components deployed inside a kubernetes cluster
            
          </li>
        
        
      </ul>
    </details>
  </div>
</div>

            <li>

Meshery provides several extension points for working with different cloud native infrastructure via <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/adapters">adapters</a>, <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/load-generators">load generators</a> and <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/providers">providers</a>.
              
            </li>
          
        
          
            <li>
              <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/api">Extensibility: APIs</a>

            </li>
          
        
          
            <li>
              <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/build-time">Extensibility: Build-time</a>
              
                - System integrators can supply build-time configuration, data, packages, and other extensions to Meshery's container image.
              
            </li>
          
        
          
            <li>
              <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/authorization">Extensibility: Authorization</a>
              
                - Meshery architecture is extensible. Meshery provides several extension points for working with different cloud native projects via authorization, adapters, load generators and providers.
              
            </li>
          
        
          
        
          
            <li>
              <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/load-generators">Extensibility: Load Generators</a>
              
                - Meshery offers support for more types of Kubernetes and cloud native infrastructure than any other project or product in the world. Meshery uses adapters for more deeply managing specific types of infrastructure.
              
            </li>
          
        
          
            <li>
              <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/providers">Extensibility: Providers</a>
              
                - Meshery uses providers to enrich the level of depth by which it manages cloud native infrastructure.
              
            </li>
          
        
          
            <li>
              <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/ui">Extensibility: UI</a>

            </li>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });

          }, 1000);
        }

        <div class="td-content">
           
<h4 id="accessing-meshery-ui">Accessing Meshery UI</h4>

<p>After successfully deploying Meshery, you can access Meshery’s web-based user interface. Your default browser will automatically open and navigate to Meshery UI (default location is <a href="http://localhost:9081">http://localhost:9081</a>).</p>

<p>You can use the following command to open Meshery UI in your default browser:</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre" style="font-size: 1.75rem !important;">
<div class="codeblock">
<code class="clipboardjs">$ mesheryctl system dashboard </code>
</div>
</pre>

<p>If you have installed Meshery on Kubernetes or a remote host, you can access Meshery UI by exposing it as a Kubernetes service or by port forwarding to Meshery UI.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre" style="font-size: 1.75rem !important;">
<div class="codeblock">
<code class="clipboardjs">$ mesheryctl system dashboard --port-forward </code>
</div>
</pre>

<p>Depending on how you have networking configured in Kubernetes, you can use kubectl to port forward to the Meshery UI.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre" style="font-size: 1.75rem !important;">
<div class="codeblock">
<code class="clipboardjs">$ kubectl port-forward svc/meshery 9081:9081 --namespace meshery</code>
</div>
</pre>

<h4 id="verify-kubernetes-connection">Verify Kubernetes Connection</h4>

<p>After installing Meshery, regardless of the installation type, it is important to verify that your kubeconfig file has been uploaded correctly via the UI.</p>

<ol>
  <li>In the Meshery UI, navigate to <strong>Lifecycle</strong> from the menu on the left.</li>
  <li>Click on Connections.</li>
  <li>Ensure that your cluster appears in the list of connections and is marked as <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">Connected</code>.</li>
  <li>Click on the cluster name to perform a ping test and confirm that Meshery can communicate with your cluster.</li>
</ol>

<details>
<summary>Customizing Your Meshery Provider Callback URL</summary>

<p>
  Meshery Server supports customizing your <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/providers">Meshery Provider</a> authentication flow callback URL. This is helpful when deploying Meshery behind multiple layers of networking infrastructure.
</p>

<p>
  For production deployments, it is recommended to access the Meshery UI by setting up a reverse proxy or using a LoadBalancer. By specifying a custom redirect endpoint, you can ensure that authentication flows complete successfully, even when multiple routing layers are involved.
</p>

<p>
  <b>Note</b>: For production deployments, it is important to select the <code>Remote Provider</code> in order to control which identity providers are authorized. Learn more about this in the <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/providers">Extensibility: Providers</a> guide.
</p>

<p>
  Define a custom callback URL by setting up the <code>MESHERY_SERVER_CALLBACK_URL</code> environment variable before installing Meshery.
</p>

<p>
  To customize the authentication flow callback URL, use the following command:
</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">$ MESHERY_SERVER_CALLBACK_URL=https://custom-host mesheryctl system start</div></div>
</pre>

<p>
  Meshery should now be running in your Kubernetes cluster and the Meshery UI should be accessible at the <code>EXTERNAL IP</code> of the <code>meshery</code> service.
</p>

</details>
   <br/>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

        <div class="td-content">
           <h1>Quick Start with Codespaces <img src="/v0.8/assets/img/platforms/codespaces.png" style="width:35px;height:35px;" /></h1>

<p>Use Minikube in GitHub Codespaces to setup your development environment for Meshery.</p>

<div class="prereqs"><p><strong style="font-size: 20px;">Prerequisites</strong> </p> 
  <ol>
    <li>Install the Meshery command line client, <a href="/v0.8/installation/mesheryctl" class="meshery-light">mesheryctl</a>.</li>
  </ol>
</div>

<h2 id="available-deployment-methods">Available Deployment Methods</h2>

<ul>
  <li><a href="#in-cluster-installation">In-cluster Installation</a>
    <ul>
      <li><a href="#preflight-checks">Preflight Checks</a>
        <ul>
          <li><a href="#preflight-cluster-connectivity">Preflight: Cluster Connectivity</a></li>
        </ul>
      </li>
      <li><a href="#installation-using-mesheryctl">Installation: Using <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code></a></li>
      <li><a href="#installation-using-helm">Installation: Using Helm</a></li>
      <li><a href="#installation-manual-steps">Installation: Manual Steps</a></li>
    </ul>
  </li>
  <li><a href="#post-installation-steps">Post-Installation Steps</a></li>
</ul>

<h1 id="in-cluster-installation">In-cluster Installation</h1>

<p>Follow the steps below to install Meshery in your Minikube cluster.</p>

<h2 id="preflight-checks">Preflight Checks</h2>

<p>Read through the following considerations prior to deploying Meshery on Minikube.</p>

<h3 id="preflight-cluster-connectivity">Preflight: Cluster Connectivity</h3>

<p>You can develop and run Meshery in GitHub Codespaces using your choice of tool:</p>

<ul>
  <li>A command shell, via an SSH connection initiated using GitHub CLI.</li>
  <li>One of the JetBrains IDEs, via the JetBrains Gateway.</li>
  <li>The Visual Studio Code desktop application.</li>
  <li>A browser-based version of Visual Studio Code.</li>
</ul>

<div class="alert alert-dark">
<h4 class="alert-heading">Choice of Codespaces Tool</h4>
For the best experience, run Codespaces in your locally <a href="https://docs.github.com/en/codespaces/developing-in-codespaces/developing-in-a-codespace">installed IDE</a>. Alternatively, you can <br /><a href="https://github.com/codespaces/new?hide_repo_select=true&amp;ref=master&amp;repo=157554479&amp;machine=premiumLinux"><img alt="Open in GitHub Codespaces" src="https://github.com/codespaces/badge.svg" /></a>
</div>

<p>Start Minikube, if it is not already running, using the following command:</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre" style="font-size: 1.75rem !important;">
<div class="codeblock">
<code class="clipboardjs">minikube start --cpus 4 --memory 4096</code>
</div>
</pre>
<p>Please allocate CPUs based on the machine you selected in GitHub Codespaces. To check the status of your Minikube cluster:</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre" style="font-size: 1.75rem !important;">
<div class="codeblock">
<code class="clipboardjs">minikube status</code>
</div>
</pre>
<p>Verify your kubeconfig’s current context.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre" style="font-size: 1.75rem !important;">
<div class="codeblock">
<code class="clipboardjs">kubectl cluster-info</code>
</div>
</pre>

<h2 id="installation-using-mesheryctl">Installation: Using <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl</code></h2>

<p>Use Meshery’s CLI to streamline your connection to your Minikube cluster. Configure Meshery to connect to your Minikube cluster by executing:</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre" style="font-size: 1.75rem !important;">
<div class="codeblock">
<code class="clipboardjs">$ mesheryctl system config minikube</code>
</div>
</pre>

<p>Once configured, execute the following command to start Meshery.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre" style="font-size: 1.75rem !important;">
<div class="codeblock">
<code class="clipboardjs">$ mesheryctl system start</code>
</div>
</pre>

<p>If you encounter any authentication issues, you can use <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">mesheryctl system login</code>. For more information, click <a href="/v0.8/guides/mesheryctl/authenticate-with-meshery-via-cli">here</a> to learn more.</p>

<h2 id="installation-using-helm">Installation: Using Helm</h2>

<p>For detailed instructions on installing Meshery using Helm V3, please refer to the <a href="/v0.8/installation/kubernetes/helm">Helm Installation</a> guide.</p>

<h2 id="installation-manual-steps">Installation: Manual Steps</h2>

<p>You may also manually generate and load the kubeconfig file for Meshery to use:</p>

<p><strong>The following configuration yaml will be used by Meshery. Copy and paste the following in your config file</strong> :</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre" style="font-size: 1.75rem !important;">
<div class="codeblock">
<code class="clipboardjs">apiVersion: v1
clusters:

- cluster:
  certificate-authority-data: &lt; cert shortcutted &gt;
  server: https://192.168.99.100:8443
  name: minikube
  contexts:
- context:
  cluster: minikube
  user: minikube
  name: minikube
  current-context: minikube
  kind: Config
  preferences: {}
  users:
- name: minikube
  user:
  client-certificate-data: &lt; cert shortcutted &gt;
  client-key-data: &lt; key shortcutted &gt;</code>
</div>
</pre>

<p><em>Note</em>: Make sure <em>current-context</em> is set to <em>minikube</em>.</p>

<p><br />
<strong>To allow Meshery to auto detect your config file, Run</strong> :</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre" style="font-size: 1.75rem !important;">
<div class="codeblock">
<code class="clipboardjs">kubectl config view --minify --flatten &gt; config_minikube.yaml</code>
</div>
</pre>

<p><br />
Meshery should now be connected with your managed Kubernetes instance. Take a look at the <a href="/v0.8/guides">Meshery guides</a> for advanced usage tips.</p>

<h1 id="post-installation-steps">Post-Installation Steps</h1>

<p>Optionally, you can verify the health of your Meshery deployment using <a href="/v0.8/reference/mesheryctl/system/check">mesheryctl system check</a>.</p>

<p>You’re ready to use Meshery! Open your browser and navigate to the Meshery UI.</p>

<h4 id="accessing-meshery-ui">Accessing Meshery UI</h4>

<p>After successfully deploying Meshery, you can access Meshery’s web-based user interface. Your default browser will automatically open and navigate to Meshery UI (default location is <a href="http://localhost:9081">http://localhost:9081</a>).</p>

<p>You can use the following command to open Meshery UI in your default browser:</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre" style="font-size: 1.75rem !important;">
<div class="codeblock">
<code class="clipboardjs">$ mesheryctl system dashboard </code>
</div>
</pre>

<p>If you have installed Meshery on Kubernetes or a remote host, you can access Meshery UI by exposing it as a Kubernetes service or by port forwarding to Meshery UI.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre" style="font-size: 1.75rem !important;">
<div class="codeblock">
<code class="clipboardjs">$ mesheryctl system dashboard --port-forward </code>
</div>
</pre>

<p>Depending on how you have networking configured in Kubernetes, you can use kubectl to port forward to the Meshery UI.</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre" style="font-size: 1.75rem !important;">
<div class="codeblock">
<code class="clipboardjs">$ kubectl port-forward svc/meshery 9081:9081 --namespace meshery</code>
</div>
</pre>

<h4 id="verify-kubernetes-connection">Verify Kubernetes Connection</h4>

<p>After installing Meshery, regardless of the installation type, it is important to verify that your kubeconfig file has been uploaded correctly via the UI.</p>

<ol>
  <li>In the Meshery UI, navigate to <strong>Lifecycle</strong> from the menu on the left.</li>
  <li>Click on Connections.</li>
  <li>Ensure that your cluster appears in the list of connections and is marked as <code class="language-plaintext highlighter-rouge">Connected</code>.</li>
  <li>Click on the cluster name to perform a ping test and confirm that Meshery can communicate with your cluster.</li>
</ol>

<details>
<summary>Customizing Your Meshery Provider Callback URL</summary>

<p>
  Meshery Server supports customizing your <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/providers">Meshery Provider</a> authentication flow callback URL. This is helpful when deploying Meshery behind multiple layers of networking infrastructure.
</p>

<p>
  For production deployments, it is recommended to access the Meshery UI by setting up a reverse proxy or using a LoadBalancer. By specifying a custom redirect endpoint, you can ensure that authentication flows complete successfully, even when multiple routing layers are involved.
</p>

<p>
  <b>Note</b>: For production deployments, it is important to select the <code>Remote Provider</code> in order to control which identity providers are authorized. Learn more about this in the <a href="/v0.8/extensibility/providers">Extensibility: Providers</a> guide.
</p>

<p>
  Define a custom callback URL by setting up the <code>MESHERY_SERVER_CALLBACK_URL</code> environment variable before installing Meshery.
</p>

<p>
  To customize the authentication flow callback URL, use the following command:
</p>

<pre class="codeblock-pre"><div class="codeblock">
 <div class="clipboardjs">$ MESHERY_SERVER_CALLBACK_URL=https://custom-host mesheryctl system start</div></div>
</pre>

<p>
  Meshery should now be running in your Kubernetes cluster and the Meshery UI should be accessible at the <code>EXTERNAL IP</code> of the <code>meshery</code> service.
</p>

</details>

<p>For further information to access Meshery UI or port forwarding in GitHub Codespaces, read the <a href="https://docs.github.com/en/codespaces/developing-in-a-codespace/forwarding-ports-in-your-codespace?tool=vscode">docs</a></p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

           <script type="text/javascript">
    function toggle_visibility(id) {
       var e = document.getElementById(id);
       if(e.style.visibility == 'visible') {
          e.style.display = 'none';
          e.style.visibility = 'hidden';
      }
       else {

          e.style.display = 'table-row';
          e.style.visibility = 'visible';
          }
    }
    function handleEdgeCheckboxChange(){
        let e = document.getElementsByClassName("edge")
        let stable = document.getElementsByClassName("stable")
        let stable_box = document.getElementById("checkbox_stable")
        for(let i = 0; i <e.length;i++){
            if(e[i].classList.contains("edge_visible") ){
                e[i].classList.remove("edge_visible")
                if(!stable_box.checked){
                    stable_box.checked=true;
                    handleStableCheckboxChange();
                }
        }
        else{
                e[i].classList.add("edge_visible")
        }
        }
    }
    function handleStableCheckboxChange(){
        let e = document.getElementsByClassName("stable")
        let edge_box = document.getElementById("checkbox_edge")
        for(let i = 0; i <e.length;i++){
            if(e[i].classList.contains("stable_visible")){
                e[i].classList.remove("stable_visible")
                if(!edge_box.checked){
                    edge_box.checked=true;
                    handleEdgeCheckboxChange();
                }
        }
        else{
                e[i].classList.add("stable_visible")
        }
        }
    }

</script>

<h1 id="compatibility-matrix">Compatibility Matrix</h1>

<p>Meshery Server and Meshery Adapters are tested daily for their compatibility with the infrastructure they manage and the platforms Meshery deploys on (Kubernetes and Docker). End-to-end test results are automatically posted to the following compatibility matrix.</p>

    }
    .tooltipss{
      position:relative;
      width:fit-content;
      cursor:pointer;
      margin-right: auto;
      margin-left: auto;
    }
    .tooltipss .tooltiptext {
    visibility: hidden;
    width: 120px;
    background-color: #555;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 5px 0;
    position: absolute;
    z-index: 1;
    bottom: 125%;
    left: 50%;
    margin-left: -60px;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s;
    }

  .tooltipss .tooltiptext::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 100%;
    left: 50%;
    margin-left: -5px;
    border-width: 5px;
    border-style: solid;
    border-color: #555 transparent transparent transparent;
  }
  .tooltipss:hover .tooltiptext {
    visibility: visible;
    opacity: 1;
}


</style>

<script>
  function showCompatability () {
      let percentContainer = document.querySelectorAll(".compatibility")
      for(let i = 0 ; i<percentContainer.length;i++){
        let percentage = parseFloat(percentContainer[i].innerHTML);
        if (percentage >= 90.00){
          percentContainer[i].innerHTML = `
            <div class = "tooltipss" style="text-align:center">
              <img src = "/assets/img/passing.svg" class = "yellowCheckbox" >
              <span class = "tooltiptext">${percentage}%</span>
            </div>
          `
        }
        else if(percentage >=1 && percentage<=89.99){
          percentContainer[i].innerHTML = `<div class = "tooltipss" style="text-align:center">
              <img src = "/assets/img/YellowCheck.svg" class = "yellowCheckbox" >
              <span class = "tooltiptext">${percentage}%</span>
            </div>`
        }
        else if(percentage < 0){
           percentContainer[i].innerHTML = `<div class = "tooltipss" style="text-align:center">
              <img src = "/assets/img/na-icon.svg" class = "yellowCheckbox" >
              <span class = "tooltiptext">Not Applicable</span>
            </div>`
        }
        else{
           percentContainer[i].innerHTML = `<div class = "tooltipss" style="text-align:center">
              <img src = "/assets/img/failing.svg" class = "yellowCheckbox" >
              <span class = "tooltiptext">${percentage}%</span>
            </div>`
        }
      }
    }
  function clickIcon(serviceMesh){
    location.href = `/installation/compatibility-matrix/${serviceMesh}-past-results`
  }

showCompatability()
</script>

<h2 id="integration-tests">Integration Tests</h2>

<p>As a key aspect of Meshery, its integrations with other systems are routinely tested. Unit and integration tests before and after every pull request (before code is to be merged into the project and after code is merged into the project). End-to-end tests are run nightly and automatically posted to the following test matrix.</p>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<h2>Meshery-cilium Integration Tests</h2>

<p>This page shows all the integration test run on Meshery-cilium in the past.</p>

<script type="text/javascript">
  function toggle_visibility(id) {
    var e = document.getElementById(id);
    if (e.style.visibility == "visible") {
      e.style.display = "none";
      e.style.visibility = "hidden";
    } else {
      e.style.display = "table-row";
      e.style.visibility = "visible";
    }
  }
  function handleEdgeCheckboxChange() {
    let e = document.getElementsByClassName("edge");
    let stable = document.getElementsByClassName("stable");
    let stable_box = document.getElementById("checkbox_stable");
    for (let i = 0; i < e.length; i++) {
      if (e[i].classList.contains("edge_visible")) {
        e[i].classList.remove("edge_visible");
        if (!stable_box.checked) {
          stable_box.checked = true;
          handleStableCheckboxChange();
        }
      } else {
        e[i].classList.add("edge_visible");
      }
    }
  }
  function handleStableCheckboxChange() {
    let e = document.getElementsByClassName("stable");
    let edge_box = document.getElementById("checkbox_edge");
    for (let i = 0; i < e.length; i++) {
      if (e[i].classList.contains("stable_visible")) {
        e[i].classList.remove("stable_visible");
        if (!edge_box.checked) {
          edge_box.checked = true;
          handleEdgeCheckboxChange();
        }
      } else {
        e[i].classList.add("stable_visible");
      }
    }
  }
</script>

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>

<h2>meshery-consul Integration Tests</h2>

<p>This page shows all the integration test run on meshery-consul in the past.</p>

<script type="text/javascript">
  function toggle_visibility(id) {
    var e = document.getElementById(id);
    if (e.style.visibility == "visible") {
      e.style.display = "none";
      e.style.visibility = "hidden";
    } else {
      e.style.display = "table-row";
      e.style.visibility = "visible";
    }
  }
  function handleEdgeCheckboxChange() {
    let e = document.getElementsByClassName("edge");
    let stable = document.getElementsByClassName("stable");
    let stable_box = document.getElementById("checkbox_stable");
    for (let i = 0; i < e.length; i++) {
      if (e[i].classList.contains("edge_visible")) {
        e[i].classList.remove("edge_visible");
        if (!stable_box.checked) {
          stable_box.checked = true;
          handleStableCheckboxChange();
        }
      } else {
        e[i].classList.add("edge_visible");
      }
    }
  }
  function handleStableCheckboxChange() {
    let e = document.getElementsByClassName("stable");
    let edge_box = document.getElementById("checkbox_edge");
    for (let i = 0; i < e.length; i++) {
      if (e[i].classList.contains("stable_visible")) {
        e[i].classList.remove("stable_visible");
        if (!edge_box.checked) {
          edge_box.checked = true;
          handleEdgeCheckboxChange();
        }
      } else {
        e[i].classList.add("stable_visible");
      }
    }
  }
</script>

  .checkbox {

</style>

  src="https://code.jquery.com/jquery-3.3.1.min.js"

<script>
$(document).ready(function() {

    var toc = $('#TOC');

    // Select each header
    sections = $('.td-content h1');
        $.each(sections, function(idx, v) {
            section = $(v);
            var div_id = $(section).attr('id');
            if(!section.hasClass('noTOC')){
               var div_text = section.text().split('¶')[0];
              var parent = $("#" + div_id)
              var content = '<li id="link_' + div_id + '" class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + div_id + '" title="' + div_text +'">' + div_text +'</a></li>';
              $(document).find(toc).append(content);
            }

            // Add section code to subnavigation
            var children = $('<nav class="md-nav"><ul class="md-nav__list"></nav></ul>')
            var contenders = $("#" + div_id).nextUntil("h1");
            $.each(contenders, function(idx, contender){
               if( !$(contender).hasClass("noTOC") && ($(contender).is('h2') || $(contender).is('h3')) ) {
                   var contender_id = $(contender).attr('id');
                   var contender_text = $(contender).text().split('¶')[0];
                   var content = '<li class="md-nav__item"><a class="md-nav__link" href="#' + contender_id + '" title="' + contender_text +'">' + contender_text +'</a></li>';
                   children.append(content);
                }
             })
             $("#link_" + div_id).append(children);
        });
        //added 'selected' tag to the first element of toc
        $('.md-nav__link').first().addClass('selected');

        $(window).scroll(function(e){
          // Detect how far are we from the top of the page
          let windowTop = $(this).scrollTop();
          // Loop through every navigation menu item
          $('.md-nav__link').each(function (event) {       
              if (windowTop >= $($(this).attr('href')).offset().top - 100) {
              // Remove 'selected' from previously highlighted menu items
              $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              // Highlight the current menu item by adding 'selected' class
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
          if($(window).scrollTop() + $(window).height() > $(document).height() - 10) {
            $('.selected').removeClass('selected');
              $(this).addClass('selected');
          }
        });
      })
      // Smooth scroll to target section when clicking on TOC link
      $('a[href^="#"]').on('click', function(event) {
        event.preventDefault();
        var target = $(this.hash);
        if (target.length) {
          $('html, body').animate({
          scrollTop: target.offset().top - 115
          }, 1000);
        }
      });
    });
</script>
